## Verification

List the relevant checks and any limitations. Include a terminal capture for visual changes.

## Compatibility and data

Describe changes to CLI behavior, storage, agent integrations, or installation.
Include migration or backup steps if needed; otherwise write "No compatibility changes."

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] My branch was created from `dev`.
- [ ] This pull request targets `dev`, not `main`.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and checks.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and the changelog for user-facing behavior.
- [ ] I linked resolved/related issues or explained why there is no issue.
- [ ] I included no private memories, secrets, or generated build artifacts.
